name: Vassbovik - Glimmingen
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage from Vassbovik to Glimmingen, mostly on gravel/dirt road, forest path, local exercise tracks and a little asphalt; no ferry, rowboat or official alternate geometry found; keep a Glimmingen motorstadion wayfinding/currentness warning

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 12. Vassbovik - Glimmingen
keyFacts: Canonical current name is Vassbovik - Glimmingen.
Official WST slug is 12-vassbovik-glimmingen.
Official direction is Vassbovik to Glimmingen.
Official distance is 12 km / 12000 m.
Official estimated time is 5 h.
Official difficulty is blue / medium.
Surface is gravel road, forest path and a little asphalt.
Stage is in Uddevalla municipality.

Official narrative describes a varied, not especially demanding stage from hilly but relatively gentle Vassbovik, mostly on easy forest roads and paths, then local hiking/exercise tracks, Stenhult sports field, open field edges, mixed forest and agricultural landscapes.
Grevesten near Stenshult is highlighted as an Iron Age grave with round stone setting and standing stone.
WST says Vassbovik is difficult to reach by bus, while Glimmingen has a bus stop with the same name.
WST says no proposed accommodation in Vassbovik or Glimmingen and suggests bus from Glimmingen toward Uddevalla for overnight stay.
